_doc: The workspace declared as data: what cannot be measured about each unit (CODE_STANDARD section 0).
Membership is measured, not listed here: a folder holding .git belongs (check_temp_artifacts.py).
cascade: the release order push.ps1 walks; blendertk shares mayatk's tier, after it and before tentacle.

units: every front door with a CLAUDE.md, in root dispatch-table order. release is cascade, standalone (own publish.yml) or none; role product marks the unit no other package may import (check_layers.py).
Restatements (root CLAUDE.md dispatch table, CI sibling lists) are checked by scripts/sync_workspace.py --check.

units.domain: Generic Qt UI library; no DCC/app logic
Maya 2025+ host library (UI moving to tentacle)
Blender 4.x+ host library, mirrors mayatk (UI moving to tentacle)
The product: every tool, panel and Slots class
